scope: dogfood — commit-msg-check against this project own three repositories

decision.change: requireType 3-state, default warn; shape rules stay error
decision.why: 61/61 type-missing hits were Conventional Commits style, not defects. A default error blocked 83% of a codebase that is fine, including every Chinese subject; 58 subject-length hits were real. Splitting the two kinds of rule keeps the tool installable on any repo while still erroring on the defect.
decision.backCompat: 0.1.0 booleans map to error/off; unknown policy string falls back to warn, never off

verified: npx default -> 1 error 1 warn, policy warn

verified.wrongEstimate: a 61-char CJK subject passed — CJK is compact, do not eyeball length

selfObservation: the commit that shipped 0.2.0 was itself 75 chars and would now be blocked by the hook it shipped
